name: the-pit-video
description: The Pit product demo video — Remotion, every frame and every sound is code.

scripts.render: npm run audio && remotion render ThePitDemo out/the-pit-1920x1080.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=14 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=320k --x264-preset=slow
scripts.stills:pitch: npm run audio:pitch && node --import tsx scripts/render-stills.ts pitch
scripts.render:pitch: npm run script:pitch && npm run audio:pitch && remotion render ThePitPitch out/the-pit-pitch-1920x1080.mp4 --props=src/pitch/narrated-props.json --codec=h264 --crf=14 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=320k --x264-preset=slow
scripts.render:pitch:music: npm run script:pitch && npm run audio:pitch && remotion render ThePitPitch out/the-pit-pitch-music-only-1920x1080.mp4 --props=src/pitch/music-props.json --codec=h264 --crf=14 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=320k --x264-preset=slow
